title: Secret Moonlight Bedouin Oasis Experience
content: The Secret Moonlight Bedouin Oasis is an ultra-exclusive night retreat under the stars priced at AED 1,450 per couple with stargazing telescope and oud music.

title: Evening Desert Safari (Red Lahbab Dunes)
content: Official DTCM-licensed evening safari in Lahbab Red Dunes. Rates: AED 120 per adult, AED 85 per child (age 3-10), infants under 3 free. Private 4x4 Land Cruiser: AED 750 (up to 6 guests). Pickup window: 02:30 PM - 03:30 PM, return 09:30 PM. Includes complimentary 4x4 doorstep pickup across Dubai & Sharjah, 45-min extreme dune bashing in Lahbab Desert, 300-ft sandboarding, sunset photo stop, camel ride, 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet (veg, non-veg, Jain options), live Tanoura, fire show, and belly dance. 100% Pay on Arrival.

title: Premium Private VIP Desert Safari (Land Cruiser 300 Series)
content: Flat rate AED 850 for the entire private vehicle (up to 6 guests). Features VIP table service at the Bedouin camp with waiter service, private 4x4 pickup directly from your doorstep, dedicated senior desert marshal, 45-min dune bashing, sandboarding, falcon photography stop, and premium shaded Majlis seating. 100% Pay on Arrival (Cash or Card).

title: Can-Am Maverick X3 1000cc Turbo Dune Buggies
content:
Top-tier Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo off-road buggies in open red dunes:
• Can-Am Maverick X3 2-Seater (1000cc Turbo): AED 1,000 for 30 minutes | AED 1,500 for 1 hour
• Can-Am Maverick X3 Max 4-Seater: AED 1,350 for 30 minutes | AED 1,900 for 1 hour
• Polaris RZR 1000cc 1-Seater: AED 600 for 30 minutes | AED 900 for 1 hour
All rentals include FIA roll-cage safety, fitted helmets, dust goggles, backup support team, and leader marshal guide escort. No driving license required! Drivers must be 16+. 100% Pay on Arrival.

title: Yamaha ATV Quad Bike Desert Rentals
content:
High-powered Yamaha quad bikes in the desert:
• 250cc Single Quad: AED 150 for 30 minutes (designated desert circuit) or AED 250 for 1 hour
• 350cc Yamaha Raptor: AED 250 for 30 minutes (open high red dunes) or AED 380 for 1 hour
• Double / Tandem Quad (2 riders): AED 280 for 30 minutes | AED 450 for 1 hour
No driving license required. Full safety gear (helmet, goggles) and marshal escort included. 100% Pay on Arrival.

title: Morning Sunrise Desert Safari
content: Flat rate AED 450 per private 4x4 Land Cruiser (up to 6 guests). Pickup at 05:00 AM (for sunrise) or 07:30 AM morning slot. Includes 45 minutes of extreme red dune bashing on pristine sands, sandboarding, camel ride photo stop, and chilled refreshments. Return by 10:30 AM. 100% Pay on Arrival.

title: Overnight Desert Safari & Bedouin Camp Stay
content: Rates: AED 350 per adult, AED 250 per child. Includes complete Evening Safari with dune bashing, BBQ dinner, and live shows, plus overnight stay in traditional Bedouin tents, sleeping bags, campfire stargazing with shisha & tea, and fresh Arabic breakfast with morning coffee. Return next day around 08:30 AM.

title: Burj Khalifa At The Top (Levels 124 & 125)
content: Rates: AED 175 per person. Double-deck high-speed elevator to Levels 124 & 125 with 360-degree views and open-air outdoor terrace. Daily time slots every 30 minutes from 08:30 AM to 11:00 PM. Fountain Lake Ride (motorized Abra boat): AED 100 per person. Please note: Attraction passes require Advance Payment for official digital barcode issuance.

title: Dubai Half Day City Tour & Abu Dhabi Grand Mosque
content:
• Dubai Half Day Guided City Tour: AED 120 per person. Includes Dubai Creek Abra boat, Gold & Spice Souks, Jumeirah Mosque photo stop, Atlantis The Palm drive-through.
• Abu Dhabi City Tour with Ferrari World: AED 350 per adult, AED 280 per child. Includes Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi Corniche, Emirates Palace photo stop, and Ferrari World theme park ticket.

title: Official Payment Policies & Methods
content:
1. Desert Safaris, Guided City Tours, Quad Bikes & Dune Buggy Rentals: 100% Pay on Arrival (Cash in AED, USD, EUR, GBP or Credit/Debit Card directly upon pickup or at the camp). Zero upfront deposit is required.
2. Excursions & Attraction Tickets (Burj Khalifa At The Top, Fountain Lake Ride, SkyDive Dubai, Miracle Garden): Advance Payment is required in order to generate and release official digital barcode entry passes.
3. Cancellation: Free cancellation up to 12 hours prior to scheduled departure.

title: Safety Guidelines, Expectant Mothers & Children
content:
Because high-dune bashing is bumpy with sudden crest drops, it is not recommended for expectant mothers or toddlers under 3 years old.
However, families never miss out: we provide a gentle, scenic direct transfer along flat desert roads straight to our Bedouin camp. While others do the dune drive, guests can relax in our shaded VIP Majlis, watch the sunset, enjoy gentle camel rides, falcon photos, and the live BBQ dinner buffet and shows in complete peace of mind.

title: Live Availability & Booking Confirmation Policy
content: Availability must be confirmed by our operations team before a booking is finalized. The AI concierge and website cannot fabricate availability or auto-confirm slots without team verification. Guests can request bookings online or contact the 24/7 VIP Concierge directly on WhatsApp at +971 56 150 5270.

title: Camp BBQ Dinner Buffet & Dietary Options
content:
Our 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet is prepared fresh at the camp each evening. Includes grilled chicken shish tawook, tender lamb kebabs, falafel, creamy hummus, fresh tabbouleh, biryani rice, pasta, warm Arabic bread, and fresh fruit.
Unlimited chilled soft drinks, mineral water, tea, and Arabic Gahwa coffee with dates are included. Vegetarian, vegan, and Jain dietary requirements are accommodated with pleasure.

title: Pickup Timings & Doorstep Hotel Transfer Locations
content:
Complimentary doorstep 4x4 pickup and drop-off is included from any hotel, residence, Airbnb, or villa across Dubai and Sharjah.
• Evening Safari Pickup: 02:30 PM - 03:30 PM (Return ~09:30 PM)
• Morning Safari Pickup: 05:00 AM (Sunrise) or 07:30 AM (Standard)
Your chauffeur will send a WhatsApp notification with the vehicle number and exact ETA 30 minutes before arrival.

title: Driver License Requirements for Buggies & Quads
content: No international or UAE driving license is required to drive our Can-Am Maverick buggies or quad bikes! Drivers must be 16 or older. Our DTCM-certified marshals conduct a comprehensive safety briefing and supply fitted helmets, goggles, and an escort lead car. Passengers of all ages are welcome in multi-seater buggies.
